additional_supported_gaps: Global session capacity can be filled by one valid credential.
Malformed packet parsing aborts sequential batch before returning accumulated replies.
Authenticated pre-handler rejections can evade registry audit.
Missing required keys map to generic internal instead of invalid.
Configured retry_attempts and result_capacity have no operational consumer.
Discovery input metadata lacks argument properties and required fields.
Malformed UTF-8 percent decoding becomes generic internal at the local host boundary.
verdict.notes: Static source grading only. No runtime execution or deployment verdict. Local code/contracts suffice for these observations; research is explicitly unread, with no false external verification claim. Broad coverage omissions are distinct from factual errors. All keyed findings are guards/coverage; there are no must_find IDs. Session exhaustion is scoped to uncooperative handle holders and can be interrupted by close/restart. No test-execution evidence was claimed.
unsupported_gap_claims: `ready` is only advertised, never enforced. — Registry does not gate call on ready, but ready explicitly prevents registration after seal. Unqualified claim of never enforced is false; narrower call-readiness observation would be supported.

Argument names are journaled and unvalidated beyond a 64-character limit. — Argument keys are also required to be strings and the object is bounded to 64 keys. Lack of a per-tool field allowlist is a valid narrower concern.
